_comment: ADR-093 / CONTRACT-CHANGE MD2-6: the admin panel's per-provider qualification hint. #688 (WP-M) owns the contents. match: 'exact' compares the configured model id (case-insensitive); 'contains' matches a short name the docs give without a full id. Each entry carries the date it was measured (as_of); the top-level as_of is the newest. 'qualified' includes 'usable, with caveats' (the caveat is in reason). A model not listed is 'unmeasured'.
